scope: The prewar Republican Palace Museum in the former All Saints Cathedral, Khartoum. Include the cruciform masonry church, raised west entry, campanile and covered passage to the narthex.

originalReview.notes: Full published lower leaf shows the west portal, circular grilles, narrow covered passage and stone wall finish.
Full published upper leaf shows the tower lantern and clock stage together with the scaled ground plan.

quallaSearch.notes: The Qualla photos were screened first. The apparent public-domain mark on an interior photograph applies to the older stained glass, and the photographer uses CC BY-SA. The selected images are the two full leaves of the 24 November 1915 published plate from the University of Toronto copy. The engraved church, proposed tower and ground plan support the reconstruction, and the consecration record establishes that the tower was later built.

excludedHistoricalImagery.reason: Native Commons record dedicates the photographed stained glass as old public-domain artwork and licenses the 2007 photograph under CC BY-SA 3.0. The image lacks exterior coverage.
The anonymous external photograph has a Sudan expiration tag. Its first-publication history remains uncertain.
